conclusions: PDR-0007 and FRD17 section11 fix DOB + 18 calendar years <= trusted server evaluation date and AGE_INELIGIBLE. Reuse this authority rather than invent a new age threshold or proof requirement.

FRD29 classifies DOB as restricted and permits durable derived evidence without raw DOB. This pure evaluator has no storage or logging; downstream transaction/retention integration remains in its owning slice.

Catalog32 permits typed internal application contracts and implementation field detail; Doc02 permits a small domain module/project with testable infrastructure-free boundaries. No public API/event, database schema, provider or UX contract is triggered.

DateOnly.AddYears applies the approved calendar-year expression, including Gregorian leap/century adjustment. Addition beyond year9999 cannot become eligible at any representable evaluation date and returns ineligible without overflow.

UTC instant/date are captured from injected server TimeProvider once; no caller evaluation-date parameter or local-machine date is introduced. Active policy resolution remains a caller-owned application obligation using existing governed P1 primitives.

primary_technical_sources.purpose: Documented leap-year adjustment for calendar-year addition

business_authority: Existing PDR-0007 and FRD17 only; Microsoft API documentation establishes runtime mechanics, not Product or legal authority.
scope_boundary: Internal deterministic calculation and derived evidence only; no registration, activation, persistence, authentication, OAuth, UX or provider behavior.
